2024_general.fact: 'Unofficial General Election Results' = SOS 'Election Unofficial Results Report 2024 NOVEMBER 5TH GENERAL ELECTION November 05, 2024 STONEWALL County' (county totals by vote method); PDF CreationDate Wed Nov 6 02:05:46 2024 UTC (8:05 PM CST), Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 17:26:35 GMT (11:26 AM CST Nov 6). The only other 2024 results file is 'November 5th Election Official Results' (scan dated 2024-11-12 by file name). No unofficial precinct numbers were posted. Rule 43: county totals first seen 2024-11-05 20:05 CT in report__20241105t200546.318.pdf (SOS report, PDF CreationDate Wed Nov 6 02:05:46 2024 UTC = 8:05 PM CST Nov 5, matching the file name; no unofficial precinct numbers posted).
